problem: Case 选择器的多列卡片布局不符合用户的一列长行偏好，悬浮与键盘聚焦反馈不够及时，旧门禁反而要求多列。
scope: 仿真插件 Case 列表的布局、悬浮、键盘焦点、计数编辑、框选、滚轮调次、浏览器性能和自动化门禁；不改变插件字段与任务生成语义。
baseline: 宽屏使用 auto-fit 多列，单项高度不超过 40px，但一列长行要求无法满足；旧断言要求至少两列。
benchmarks: W3C APG vertical listbox keyboard model
Adobe React Aria ListBox stack states
Adobe React Aria Virtualizer large-list strategy
advantages: 已有框选、滚轮和批量次数编辑
disadvantages: 多列导致扫描路径跳跃
悬浮只有鼠标态而缺少统一 focus-within
未测量大量 Case 的 DOM 与反馈延迟
limitations: 框选依赖所有行的几何信息
Case 点击是增加次数而不是标准 listbox selection
旧版企业浏览器需避免新实验 API
defects: 旧质量 Oracle 与新需求冲突

metrics.name: case_column_count
metrics.measurement: Edge 每项 x 坐标唯一值

metrics.name: case_hover_response
metrics.measurement: CSS transition duration 与浏览器状态采样

hypotheses: 单列长行降低纵横视线跳跃
hover 与 focus-within 共用低延迟表面反馈能提升一致性
保留轻量原生实现比引入不匹配的 listbox/virtualizer 更兼容

stages.output: real-browser geometry, focus, interaction and resource evidence

hard_gates: exactly one Case column at wide and narrow viewports
rows fill at least 95 percent of list content width
hover feedback transition no more than 100ms
keyboard focus is visible without selecting or changing count
wheel, click, marquee and batch editing regressions remain green
success_fixtures: three Case rows share one x coordinate
focused Case retains a visible neutral/accent state
rollback: Restore the prior compact CasePicker behavior while keeping the rejected multi-column baseline as evidence.
stop_conditions: resource budget and full regression pass
design rules and counterexample are written back

promotion_decision.reason: single-column scan preference after explicit rejection and focus-state latency checks generalize to dense operator pickers

writeback: Project-specific screenshots and metrics stay in quality evidence; reusable picker routing and focus-response checks go to the user-root web interface skill.
